name: when2meet-to-gcal
description: A userscript that converts when2meet Group polls to Google Calendar events

scripts.test: node --test test/rank.test.mjs test/gcal.test.mjs test/userscript.test.mjs test/chrome-extension.test.mjs test/release-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check when2meet-to-gcal.user.js && node --check src/rank.mjs && node --check src/gcal.mjs && node --check extension/main-preamble.js && node --check extension/storage-bridge.js && node scripts/embed-icon.mjs check && node scripts/build-extension.mjs check
scripts.extension:package: pnpm run extension:build && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && ARCHIVE="when2meet-to-gcal-chrome-extension-v${VERSION}.zip" && zip -q -r "$ARCHIVE" extension && unzip -tq "$ARCHIVE" && unzip -l "$ARCHIVE" | grep -F "extension/manifest.json"
scripts.ci:all: pnpm run version:check && pnpm run icons:check && pnpm test && pnpm run check
